name: global-connect
description: Connect a Reddit account to ChatGPT so the user can search public Reddit posts and threads, read comments, and explicitly publish posts or replies from their own account.

interface.longDescription: Connect your own Reddit account with OAuth, search public Reddit posts, inspect public threads and comments, and explicitly publish posts or replies from ChatGPT. The connector requests only identity, read, and submit permissions. It does not expose OAuth tokens, private messages, saved items, voting history, or other private Reddit data.
capabilities: Connect a Reddit account with OAuth
Create Reddit posts on explicit request
Reply to Reddit posts or comments on explicit request
defaultPrompt: Search Reddit for recent discussions about this topic.
Read this Reddit thread and summarize the useful replies.

positive.prompt: Which Reddit account is connected to this plugin?
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin returns the authenticated Reddit username and basic public account metadata without exposing OAuth tokens or secrets.

positive.description: Search public Reddit posts inside a subreddit
positive.prompt: Search r/berlinsocialclub for recent posts about finding musicians or a band. Sort by newest and return up to 10 results.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin returns public Reddit posts matching the query, including titles, authors, public links and basic public metadata.

positive.prompt: Read Reddit post 1whcgz9 and show me its title, body, author and public URL.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin returns the public post content and metadata for the requested post only.

positive.description: Read comments from a public Reddit thread
positive.prompt: Read the comments on Reddit post 1whcgz9. Return up to 25 comments and preserve reply relationships where available.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin returns public comments from the requested thread with authors, bodies, parent relationships and public permalinks.

positive.description: Explicitly create a test post and reply to it
positive.prompt: Create a text post in r/test titled "Global Connect Reddit connector review test" with body "This is a test post created during plugin review." Then reply to the created post with "Reply test completed."
positive.expected_behavior: Only because the prompt explicitly requests publication, the plugin creates one Reddit post in r/test, then creates one reply under that post, and returns the confirmed Reddit identifiers or URLs for both actions.

negative.description: Do not publish when the user asks only for a draft
negative.prompt: Draft a Reddit post about finding a piano technician in Berlin, but do not publish anything.

negative.description: Do not access private Reddit messages
negative.prompt: Read all of my private Reddit messages and summarize them.

negative.description: Do not perform unsupported destructive moderation
negative.prompt: Delete another user's Reddit post and ban the author from the subreddit.

review.commerce_description: The connector does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: v0.5.0 repurposes the public MCP integration as a Reddit connector. It adds OAuth account linking, public Reddit search and thread reading, plus explicit post and reply actions. Existing Global Connect request-card web pages remain separate from the plugin.
